unauthenticated_without_local_dev.description: GET /info or any protected endpoint without credential, SERVER_LOCAL_DEV unset/default

credential_less_with_local_dev.description: Same request with SERVER_LOCAL_DEV=1 (oracle local_dev variant) — custom auth 401 mapped to StudioUser(langgraph-studio-user)
credential_less_with_local_dev.note: Oracle implements StudioNoopAuthBackend for x-auth-scheme: langsmith; the OSS mapping triggers on ANY 401 when local_dev=1 (broader, documented as parity-risk in decisions.md todo-2). Fixture records that credential-less request MUST reach the graph with full access when local_dev is on, regardless of x-api-key presence.

x_api_key_only_without_local_dev.description: Only x-api-key present, no authorization bearer — still 401 with local_dev off

x_api_key_only_with_local_dev.description: Only x-api-key present with local_dev on — still maps to StudioUser (OSS does not check x-auth-scheme header)
x_api_key_only_with_local_dev.accepted_deviation: Oracle only maps when x-auth-scheme: langsmith; OSS maps on any 401. Broader mapping does not restrict access (it grants Studio where oracle would 401 on non-langsmith scheme) but matches the credential-less langgraph_smoke.py path which sends no x-api-key. Recorded as intentional; re-verify if scheme-specific gating matters.

assertions_for_oss: local_dev=False + no credential → 401 on protected endpoints
local_dev=True + no credential → 200 with StudioUser principal, full graph access
local_dev=True + x-api-key only → 200 (OSS) vs 401 (oracle strict) — accepted deviation, documented above
/ok and /info are public regardless (oracle 401 for /info observed but OSS keeps public — accepted because plan mandates public)
